description.narrative:
Detta är ett enklare bidrag av förberedande karaktär. Det syftar till att stödja Centrum för utredande journalistik i Moldavien (CIJM), en lokal EO verksam inom mediesektorn, med syfte att utveckla intern kapacitet och policy. CIJM kommer under denna första fas av stödet (innan kärnstöd) att genomföra de prioriterade rekommendationerna från Nordic Consulting Group presenterade i den systembaserade revisionsrapporten som gjordes 2018. CIJM utvecklar institutionell kapacitet, interna rutiner, personalkunskaper och andra färdigheter för att kunna genomföra kärnstödsaktiviteter. Baserat på en kommande uppföljningsrapport som avser aktiviteter under denna första fas (rapport tas preliminärt fram i december 2019) kan Sida sedan överväga att fortsätta med kärnstöd till CIJM baserat på en strategisk plan, resultatram och den strategiska budgeten som utvecklats inför kärnstödet.
Insatsens totala budget uppgår till 263 655 SEK.

This is a simplified contribution of a preparatory nature. The intervention aims at supporting the Center for Investigative Journalism from Moldova (CIJM), a local NGO based in Moldova active in media sector, to develop internal capacities and policies. During pre-core support phase CIJM will implement priority recommendations provided by the Nordic Consulting Group in the system-based audit report produced in 2018. Therefore, CIJM will develop institutional capacities, internal routines, staff knowledge and skills to be able to implement core-support activities. Based on a follow-up report on pre-core activities to be conducted tentatively in December 2019, Sida may consider continuing with core-support with CIJM based on the Strategic Plan, RAF and strategic budget developed during pre-core support.
The interventions' total budget is 263 655 SEK.

The intervention aims at supporting the Center for Investigative Journalism from Moldova (CIJM), a local NGO based in Moldova active in media sector, to develop internal capacities and policies. During pre-core support phase CIJM supposed to implement priority recommendations provided by the Nordic Consulting Group in the system-based audit report produced in 2018. Therefore, CIJM supposed to develop institutional capacities, internal routines, staff knowledge and skills to be able to implement core-support activities to build an organisational structure, to draft relevant internal policies and to design and draft the RAF and strategic budget.

sector.narrative: Media and free flow of information

description.narrative: During the pre-core support phase, CIJM managed the following results: - Registered a new/updated version of the bylaw. - Attended capacity building events supported by the Embassy through SDA for core support partners in Moldova on organisational development: mainstreaming of Sida's main values in its strategic plan and work, monitoring and evaluation, anti-corruption and accountability etc. - Managed to draft the following internal policies (however these documents were not approved by the board): internal structural chart, risk management assessment, ToR for the board, ToR for the head of legal department, fundrasing strategy, model ToR for coordinator position, internal audit policy, internal IT development policy, gender internal policy, environmental internal policy, accountability policy, anti-corruption internal policy, GDPR internal policy, internal regulation, HR internal policy, communication strategy.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
